title: Can AI Recognize Itself? Code and results
description: Code, results, pre-registration record and negatives ledger for the paper "Can AI Recognize Itself? Why self-related indicators cannot settle machine consciousness, and what a tenth-century Kashmiri debate anticipated". A ladder of self-related indicator tests on a minimal dynamical self-model (the Spanda Self-Model) and on GPT-2 Medium, each with its cheapest cheat, an outside observer and, for language models, an exact copy, plus scrambled-weight and non-linguistic negative controls.
notes: Successor to 'Why AI Might Be Conscious — and Why No Test Can Yet Tell' (v0.1.0). Result files are CC BY 4.0 except results/transformer/b2_items.json.gz (CC BY-SA 3.0, WikiText-103); see docs/DATA_LICENSE.md.
